cond.gestational_diabetes.etiology_zh: 妊娠糖尿病發生於原先未確診糖尿病的妊娠者，核心機轉是妊娠後半期生理性 insulin resistance 增加，而胰臟 β 細胞無法分泌足夠額外 insulin 代償。胎盤與其他妊娠相關荷爾蒙使母體組織較不易利用 insulin，讓更多 glucose 可供胎兒；大多數孕婦能增加 insulin 分泌維持正常血糖，但既有 insulin resistance 或 β-cell reserve 較低者可能失代償。孕前 overweight／obesity、過度妊娠增重、家族史、先前妊娠糖尿病與 PCOS 會增加風險，但不是每一病例的充分病因，也不應用族群身分替代個人檢測。若高血糖在妊娠早期已達 overt diabetes 範圍，可能是未被辨識的 type 1 或 type 2 diabetes，而不是典型在 24–28 週顯現的妊娠糖尿病。分娩後 insulin resistance 通常下降、血糖可能恢復，但曾發病代表日後 type 2 diabetes 風險上升，並不表示原始代謝易感性已消失。
cond.gestational_diabetes.etiology_en: Gestational diabetes develops during pregnancy in a person without previously diagnosed diabetes when physiologic insulin resistance rises and pancreatic beta cells cannot supply enough additional insulin to compensate. Placental and other pregnancy-related hormones make maternal tissues less responsive to insulin, preserving more glucose for the fetus. Most pregnant people increase insulin secretion sufficiently, while those with greater pre-existing insulin resistance or lower beta-cell reserve may decompensate. Prepregnancy overweight or obesity, excessive gestational weight gain, family history, previous gestational diabetes, and polycystic ovary syndrome increase risk but are not sufficient causes in every case, and population identity should not substitute for individual testing. Hyperglycemia already meeting overt-diabetes criteria early in pregnancy may represent previously unrecognized type 1 or type 2 diabetes rather than typical gestational diabetes emerging around 24–28 weeks. Insulin resistance usually falls and glucose may normalize after delivery, but a history of gestational diabetes marks increased later type 2 diabetes risk rather than disappearance of the underlying metabolic susceptibility.

etiology_zh: NIH/NIDDK: Symptoms and Causes of Gestational Diabetes — pregnancy insulin resistance, insufficient compensatory insulin and genetic/weight associations (reviewed 2017-05); NHS: Gestational diabetes — pregnancy-onset distinction, insulin insufficiency and later type 2 diabetes risk (reviewed 2022-12-08)

cond.diabetes_insipidus.etiology_zh: 尿崩症是水分平衡障礙，並非 glucose／insulin 異常的 diabetes mellitus；共同結果是腎臟無法在需要時濃縮尿液。Arginine vasopressin deficiency（central DI）源於 hypothalamus 合成或 posterior pituitary 釋放 AVP 不足，可由腦／腦下垂體手術、腫瘤、頭部外傷、感染、缺血、發炎、自體免疫或遺傳變異造成，也可找不到原因。Arginine vasopressin resistance（nephrogenic DI）則有足量 AVP，但腎小管反應不足；原因包括遺傳性 AVPR2／AQP2 異常、lithium 等藥物、hypercalcemia、hypokalemia、尿路阻塞或腎病。Dipsogenic DI 是口渴調節中樞異常導致過量飲水及續發性多尿，須與 primary polydipsia 的行為或精神因素共同評估。Gestational DI 很少見，通常因胎盤 vasopressinase 加速分解 AVP，multiple gestation、preeclampsia／HELLP 或肝功能異常可增加風險。各型病因、檢驗與治療不同，不能僅憑口渴與多尿統稱，也須先排除高血糖、利尿劑、腎功能與電解質異常。
cond.diabetes_insipidus.etiology_en: Diabetes insipidus is a water-balance disorder, not the glucose and insulin disorder diabetes mellitus; its shared endpoint is failure to concentrate urine appropriately. Arginine vasopressin deficiency (central DI) reflects inadequate hypothalamic production or posterior-pituitary release of AVP and may follow brain or pituitary surgery, tumor, head injury, infection, ischemia, inflammation, autoimmunity, or a genetic variant, or remain unexplained. Arginine vasopressin resistance (nephrogenic DI) occurs when AVP is present but renal tubules respond inadequately; causes include inherited AVPR2 or AQP2 abnormalities, medicines such as lithium, hypercalcemia, hypokalemia, urinary obstruction, or kidney disease. Dipsogenic DI involves abnormal central thirst regulation with excess intake and secondary polyuria and must be assessed alongside behavioral or psychiatric primary polydipsia. Rare gestational DI usually results when placental vasopressinase accelerates AVP breakdown; multiple gestation, preeclampsia or HELLP, and impaired liver function can increase risk. The types have different causes, tests, and treatment and should not be grouped solely from thirst and polyuria; hyperglycemia, diuretics, kidney dysfunction, and electrolyte disorders also require exclusion.

etiology_zh: NIH/NIDDK: Diabetes Insipidus — AVP-related four-type causal framework, central injury/immune/genetic causes, nephrogenic medicines/electrolytes/obstruction and placental gestational mechanism (reviewed 2021-04); NHS: Causes of diabetes insipidus — AVP deficiency versus resistance and acquired or inherited causes (reviewed 2022-10-13)

cond.familial_hypercholesterolemia.etiology_zh: 家族性高膽固醇血症（FH）是遺傳性 LDL clearance 障礙，使 LDL cholesterol 自出生起即偏高，而不是單由飲食或缺乏運動造成。最常見是 LDLR pathogenic variant，使肝細胞 LDL receptor 數量或功能下降；APOB 變異可降低 LDL 與 receptor 結合，PCSK9 gain-of-function 可增加 receptor 分解，較少見 LDLRAP1 等變異亦可致病。LDLR、APOB 與 PCSK9 相關 FH 多為 autosomal dominant，一位受影響父母的每名子女各有 50% 機會繼承變異；少數 autosomal recessive 型或雙等位變異會造成更嚴重、較早發病的 phenotype。臨床符合 FH 者不一定能在現有 panel 找到單一 pathogenic variant，可能涉及未辨識基因或 polygenic LDL elevation，因此陰性 genetic test 不能單獨排除臨床診斷。生活型態會調整 LDL 數值與 atherosclerotic risk，但不是遺傳性 clearance 缺陷的根本來源。診斷前仍需排除 hypothyroidism、nephrotic syndrome、cholestatic liver disease 與特定藥物等 secondary hypercholesterolemia。
cond.familial_hypercholesterolemia.etiology_en: Familial hypercholesterolemia (FH) is inherited impairment of LDL clearance that raises LDL cholesterol from birth rather than high cholesterol caused solely by diet or inactivity. The most common cause is a pathogenic LDLR variant that reduces LDL-receptor number or function. APOB variants can impair LDL binding to its receptor, PCSK9 gain-of-function can increase receptor degradation, and less common variants such as LDLRAP1 can also cause disease. LDLR-, APOB-, and PCSK9-related FH is usually autosomal dominant, so each child of an affected parent has an independent 50% chance of inheriting the variant; uncommon recessive or biallelic forms produce a more severe, earlier phenotype. A person meeting clinical FH criteria may have no single pathogenic variant detected on current panels because an unrecognized gene or polygenic LDL elevation may be involved, so a negative genetic test alone does not exclude the clinical diagnosis. Lifestyle modifies LDL level and atherosclerotic risk but is not the origin of the inherited clearance defect. Hypothyroidism, nephrotic syndrome, cholestatic liver disease, and selected medicines should still be excluded as secondary causes of hypercholesterolemia.

cond.subacute_thyroiditis.etiology_zh: 亞急性甲狀腺炎（subacute granulomatous／de Quervain thyroiditis）被認為是上呼吸道病毒感染後觸發的免疫性甲狀腺發炎，而非病毒持續在甲狀腺內繁殖的可傳染感染。常在感冒、流感、腮腺炎或其他耳鼻喉感染後數週出現疼痛、腫大的 thyroid；與特定病毒的關聯並不表示每一病例都能找到病毒，也不應把所有無痛 thyroiditis 歸入此型。發炎破壞 follicles，使已儲存的 thyroid hormone 漏入循環而造成暫時性 thyrotoxicosis；這不是 Graves disease 的新合成增加。儲存量耗盡後可能短暫進入 hypothyroid phase，隨腺體修復多數恢復，但少數留下永久 hypothyroidism。遺傳易感與免疫反應可能影響發病，但此病通常不按典型家族遺傳。明顯頸痛合併發燒仍須與 suppurative bacterial thyroiditis、深頸感染、出血或腫瘤鑑別；後者的病因與處置不同。
cond.subacute_thyroiditis.etiology_en: Subacute granulomatous (de Quervain) thyroiditis is thought to be an immune-mediated thyroid inflammation triggered after an upper-respiratory viral illness rather than a contagious infection caused by ongoing viral replication within the gland. A painful enlarged thyroid often appears weeks after a cold, influenza, mumps, or another ear, sinus, or throat infection. Viral association does not mean a virus is identifiable in every case, and painless thyroiditis should not automatically be assigned to this subtype. Inflammation disrupts follicles and releases preformed thyroid hormone, causing transient thyrotoxicosis; this differs from the increased hormone synthesis of Graves disease. Depletion of stored hormone may then produce a temporary hypothyroid phase, followed by recovery as the gland heals, although a minority retain permanent hypothyroidism. Genetic susceptibility and host immune response may influence disease, but it does not usually follow a typical inherited family pattern. Marked neck pain with fever still requires distinction from suppurative bacterial thyroiditis, deep-neck infection, hemorrhage, or tumor, which have different causes and management.

etiology_zh: NIH/NLM MedlinePlus: Subacute thyroiditis — post-viral immune reaction, noninfectious boundary, painful gland and phased hormone course (reviewed 2026-01-25); Cornwall NHS Referral Management: Thyroiditis — viral trigger, destructive release of stored hormone and emergency differential context (accessed 2026-08-24)

cond.hyperuricemia.etiology_zh: 高尿酸血症是血中 urate 超過溶解與排除平衡的生化狀態，來自 uric acid 生成過多、腎臟／腸道排除不足，或兩者並存。Urate 是 endogenous cell turnover 與食物 purines 分解的終產物；多數病例以排除不足為主，慢性腎功能下降、特定 urate transporter 遺傳變異、脫水及部分藥物可降低排除。高細胞 turnover（例如部分血液腫瘤或治療後 tumor lysis）、少數 purine metabolism 遺傳病及大量 purine／alcohol／fructose 暴露可增加生成或負荷。Obesity、metabolic syndrome、hypertension 與高尿酸常共存，但相關性不等於每一個共病都是單向直接原因。高尿酸血症本身常無症狀，只有部分人形成 monosodium urate crystals 而發展 gout、tophi 或 uric-acid stones；因此 laboratory hyperuricemia 不等同 gout，正常單次 urate 也不能在急性關節炎中完全排除 gout。原因評估應包含腎功能、藥物、飲食／酒精、細胞 turnover 與家族史，而不能只歸咎於某一種食物。
cond.hyperuricemia.etiology_en: Hyperuricemia is a biochemical state in which circulating urate exceeds the balance of solubility and elimination. It results from excessive uric acid production, inadequate renal or intestinal excretion, or both. Urate is the end product of purines from endogenous cell turnover and food. Most cases predominantly involve underexcretion; chronic kidney dysfunction, selected urate-transporter variants, dehydration, and some medicines can reduce clearance. High cell turnover, including selected hematologic cancers or tumor lysis after treatment, uncommon inherited purine-metabolism disorders, and high purine, alcohol, or fructose exposure can increase production or load. Obesity, metabolic syndrome, hypertension, and hyperuricemia commonly coexist, but association does not make every comorbidity a direct one-way cause. Hyperuricemia is often asymptomatic, and only some people form monosodium urate crystals and develop gout, tophi, or uric-acid stones. Laboratory hyperuricemia therefore is not synonymous with gout, and a single normal urate result does not fully exclude gout during acute arthritis. Cause assessment should include kidney function, medicines, diet and alcohol, cell turnover, and family history rather than attributing the result to one food alone.
